why_blocked: V12 is immutable and cannot be overwritten.
The current verifier dispatches only the V12 current-generation schema.
A valid successor generation would require changing phase31_4_integrity_generations.py and adding a new generation verifier path.
The remediation authorization allows exactly one source path: the disposable authority producer.
Changing integrity verifier/generation code would violate the bounded remediation and make the successor non-independent.
required_external_decision: Authorize a separate governance successor-generation remediation, or withdraw the producer remediation and restore the pre-remediation source before any Attempt 3 authorization.
